name: Hòn Chồng
kicker: The stacked rocks on the north shore
summary: Stacked shore rocks: walk the boulders from 06:00 to 18:00 for the view up the north bay. Hòn Vợ is about 100 m south and Hòn Đỏ about 300 m southeast. The rocks sit in Vĩnh Phước, with Hòn Tre and the islands to the east.
getThere: Hòn Chồng, Vĩnh Phước, on the north shore.
heroCaption: The stacked rocks of Hòn Chồng, with the bay and the hills
body: Hòn Chồng is the larger northern group of rocks on this shore, in Vĩnh Phước. Hòn Vợ is about 100 m south. Hòn Đỏ is about 300 m southeast. From the rocks you can see Hòn Tre, núi Cô Tiên, and the islands to the east. The gate hours are 06:00–18:00.

An assembly hall on the site was built from December 2004 to March 2005 for the 2005 meeting of the bay club. The visit is the stacked rocks and the water between them. Po Nagar is the other stop on this northern shore, about 2 km from the centre.

gettingThere: The promontory is Hòn Chồng, Vĩnh Phước, on the north shore of the bay.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: Follow the shore north to Vĩnh Phước.

legs.heading: From Po Nagar
legs.body: Po Nagar and Hòn Chồng are both in Vĩnh Phước. Po Nagar is about 2 km north of the centre.
